newsitem.title: VANUATU: No damage after Vanuatu earthquake.
newsitem.headline: No damage after Vanuatu earthquake.

text.p: A severe earthquake estimated at 6.5 on the Richter scale was recorded in the South Pacific near the island state of Vanuatu but the tremor caused no damage, emergency officials said on Thursday.
The Hong Kong Royal Obervatory said the earthquake was detected at 1421 GMT Wednesday with the epicentre on the ocean floor about 110 km (70 miles) south of the island of Tanna.
"There were no injuries, damage or flooding related to the earthquake. It had no effect whatsover," a spokesman for the National Disaster Management Office told Reuters.
